cues.text: A woman has an untreated infected lesion on her face.
This is the danger area of the face. Infection here can spread to the cavernous sinus and cause thrombosis.
Now she has severe pain in her eye, and a fever.
and a pulsating proptosis: the eye is pushed forward.
These signs come from the cavernous sinus. Thrombosis here can also cause ophthalmoplegia.
So remember: ocular pain, chemosis and proptosis after a facial infection point to the cavernous sinus.
